info.title: API.SH: pisos.com
info.description: The pisos.com API from API.SH: public pisos.com data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A pisos.com estate agency: name, logo, client-since, address, phone, opening hours and description, with its listings (same fields as the search). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pisos-agency

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Agency slug: the part after /inmobiliaria- in its pisos.com link (or the agency.slug of a result).

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: Only the agency's listings for buy or rent.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page (1 = first). Pass `next_page` back here.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One pisos.com listing: title, zone, price, rooms, bathrooms, built and usable area, floor, age, condition, community fees, reference, every feature grouped as on the page, energy rating, full description, coordinates (approximate when the site says so), update date, photo/plan/video/tour counts, photos, seller type, and the agency's business details (name, address, phone, logo, agency page). A private seller's name and phone are never returned. Pass `url` or `latest=true` with search params.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pisos-listing

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: return the newest current listing of a search with the search params given alongside (keeps examples valid). Then id/url are not needed.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With latest=true: place slug for the search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pisos-new-builds

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A place slug as in pisos.com links, e.g. madrid, barcelona, valencia, alcala_de_henares.

get.description:
Flats, houses, penthouses, duplexes, studios, lofts, rustic estates, premises, offices, garages, land, storage rooms, industrial buildings and buildings for sale or rent on pisos.com (Spain), with the site's filters (price range, minimum rooms, bathrooms and area, features such as terrace, lift or pool, listed in the last week or month, reduced price) and sorts. Each result has id, link, title, zone, price, rooms, bathrooms, area, floor, short description, tag, photo count, coordinates, locality, photos and the agency (logo and agency page); private sellers are flagged without name or phone. 30 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/pisos-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place slug as in pisos.com links: madrid, madrid_capital, barcelona_capital, valencia, sevilla, malaga ...

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page (1 = first). Pass `next_page` back here.

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Comma-separated, all required: terrace, elevator, garden, pool, garage, storage, heating, air_conditioning, furnished (rent only).

parameters.name: posted
parameters.description: Only listings published in the last week or month.

parameters.name: price_reduced
parameters.description: true: only listings whose price was lowered.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
